snippet.title: Gumshoe Detective Agency: The First Case Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Gumshoe Detective Agency: The First Case is a modern homage to the detective games of the past. As a solo developer passion project, the game blends vintage computer aesthetics with narrative-driven puzzles to create a wholly unique experience.

Key Features Include:

An immersive point-and-click interface that recreates the charm and quirks of a ‘90s desktop computer

Interactive puzzles hidden inside emails, chat logs, websites, and forgotten files

A persistent mystery file system, where you collect, sort, and piece together your evidence

Easter eggs, red herrings, and that perfect mid-’90s paranoia vibe

Wishlist on Steam: tinyurl.com/wishlistgda
